comment: v5 = v4 + the gate audit (2026-08-18, third round): perception mode
retires the legacy gates whose thresholds were never tied to audibility.
The 1% amp-step default (0.09 dB!) was rejecting 20k-1.7M pairs per note
- the real cause of the 3-segment ceiling - while ear-calibrated channels
tolerate 2.5 dB per partial; kept only as a loose 3 dB perf bar. corr is
subsumed by residual; tilt/slope by the perceptual channels. The 5-cent
pitchStep gate (rejecting on smoothed-curve vibrato wiggle, 226k pairs on
Fs4) is replaced by the PITCH-STATE channel: vibrato-integrated common
pitch track mismatch at the splice points (target 3 cents, bar 12) -
the tuning-honest version, also live on non-vibrato notes.
